panels.title: Unallocated cost, 30 days

panels.description: Directly tagged cost first, shared cost by measured share, credits excluded. From the control-plane ledger; see the 'billing data as of' panel for how old it is.

targets.rawSql: WITH params AS (SELECT current_date - 30 AS since, current_date AS until), direct AS (SELECT c.cb_cell AS cell_id, c.cb_service AS service, sum(c.effective_cost) AS cost FROM cost_line_items c, params p WHERE c.charge_category = 'Usage' AND c.cb_service IS NOT NULL AND c.charge_period_start >= p.since AND c.charge_period_start < p.until GROUP BY 1, 2), shared_daily AS (SELECT c.cb_cell AS cell_id, c.charge_period_start::date AS day, sum(c.effective_cost) AS cost FROM cost_line_items c, params p WHERE c.charge_category = 'Usage' AND c.cb_cell IS NOT NULL AND c.cb_service IS NULL AND c.charge_period_start >= p.since AND c.charge_period_start < p.until GROUP BY 1, 2), shared AS (SELECT s.cell_id, a.service, sum(s.cost * a.cpu_share) AS cost FROM shared_daily s JOIN allocation_daily a ON a.cell_id = s.cell_id AND a.day = s.day GROUP BY 1, 2), vol AS (SELECT cell_id, service, sum(requests) AS req FROM request_volume_daily, params p WHERE day >= p.since AND day < p.until GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT v.cell_id, v.service, round(coalesce(d.cost, 0) + coalesce(s.cost, 0), 2) AS cost_30d, v.req AS requests_30d, round((coalesce(d.cost, 0) + coalesce(s.cost, 0)) / nullif(v.req, 0) * 1000, 6) AS cost_per_1k_req FROM vol v LEFT JOIN direct d USING (cell_id, service) LEFT JOIN shared s USING (cell_id, service) ORDER BY v.service, v.cell_id

panels.title: Cost per 1,000 requests

panels.description: Reconciliation error per cell per day. From the control-plane ledger; see the 'billing data as of' panel for how old it is.

targets.rawSql: WITH bill AS (SELECT cb_cell AS cell_id, charge_period_start::date AS day, sum(effective_cost) AS billed FROM cost_line_items WHERE charge_category = 'Usage' AND cb_cell IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2), est AS (SELECT cell_id, day, sum(opencost_estimate) AS estimated FROM allocation_daily GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT e.day, e.cell_id, round(e.estimated, 2) AS estimated, round(b.billed, 2) AS billed, round(100 * (e.estimated / nullif(b.billed, 0) - 1), 2) AS error_pct FROM est e JOIN bill b USING (cell_id, day) ORDER BY e.day DESC, e.cell_id LIMIT 30
